mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM t_application WHERE status = 4 AND deleted = 0

SELECT c.id as college_id, c.college_name as college_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as total_students FROM t_college c LEFT JOIN t_student s ON s.college_id = c.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.college_name ORDER BY total_students DESC

SELECT s.college_id, c.college_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as employed_count FROM t_application a JOIN t_student s ON a.student_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 JOIN t_college c ON s.college_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.status = 4 AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.college_id, c.college_name
SELECT COALESCE(s.major, '未设置') as major, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as total_students FROM t_student s WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.major ORDER BY total_students DESC

SELECT COALESCE(s.major, '未设置') as major, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as employed_count FROM t_application a JOIN t_student s ON a.student_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE a.status = 4 AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.major

SELECT COALESCE(c.industry, '未分类') as industry, COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) as employed_count FROM t_application a JOIN t_job j ON a.job_id = j.id AND j.deleted = 0 JOIN t_company c ON j.company_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.status = 4 AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.industry ORDER BY employed_count DESC
